name: decodo
description: Web scraping, SERP, and e-commerce data for AI agents. Handles JavaScript rendering, anti-bot/CAPTCHA, proxy rotation, and geo-targeting — through the Decodo CLI or the hosted Decodo MCP server.

DECODO_AUTH_TOKEN.title: Decodo API token
DECODO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Web Scraping API basic auth token from https://dashboard.decodo.com/playground (free account = up to 2K requests, no card). The same token authenticates the MCP server, the CLI, and the raw API.

DECODO_TOOLSETS.title: MCP toolsets (optional)
DECODO_TOOLSETS.description: Which Decodo MCP toolsets to enable, comma-separated. Defaults to "web,search". Available: web, search, ecommerce, social_media, ai. The full server exposes ~30 tools, so enable only what you need — every enabled tool's schema is resident in each request. The decodo CLI covers all targets regardless of this setting.
